description: This file declares classes related to event threading, including an EventThread class implementing IEventThread and a factory class EventThreadFactory, within the firebolt::rialto::common namespace.

classes.name: EventThreadFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating EventThread instances, implementing IEventThreadFactory.

classes.name: EventThread
classes.description: Implementation of IEventThread that manages a thread executing queued functions.

methods.name: createEventThread
methods.description: Creates and returns a new IEventThread instance with the specified thread name.

methods.name: EventThread
methods.description: Constructor initializing the EventThread with an optional thread name.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes the event queue, ensuring all queued functions are executed.

methods.name: addImpl
methods.description: Adds a function to the event thread's queue for execution.

methods.name: threadExecutor
methods.description: Internal method running in the thread, executing queued functions.
